MLI.note: SIGRH is described as about to be launched after a ministerial inspection on 20 June 2025, not as in use.
RAVEC biometric data is used to update staff files, but the document does not describe the ID system itself.

facts.fact: Nouveau Réveil reports that SIGRH, the civil-service HR system, was designed and developed by IT staff of the Malian public administration and financed exclusively from the national budget.
